author: Clare DeWitt
body: Using Andrea’s sleep plan gave us the knowledge and skills to be able to help our LO fall asleep on her own. As first time parents, we were completely overwhelmed and at our wits end as to what to do to help our girl sleep. I was frustrated and dreaded bedtime. Now, I know that even if we have rough nights, we will be okay and have the tools and can troubleshoot the problem. I also how non judgmental her plan is, it truly helps you feel like you are making the best decisions for YOUR individual baby. This made it so reassuring that we could find something that worked for her.
